game: TRANSFORMERS: More Than Meets the Eye

sections.Description:
Experience the legendary battle between Autobots and Decepticons like never before!

In TRANSFORMERS: More Than Meets the Eye, players join Optimus Prime and the Autobots in their mission to stop Megatron and the Decepticons from stealing Earth’s energy, conquering Cybertron, and dominating the universe.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- BATTLE AND STOP MEGATRON: An animatronic Megatron is ready for battle, with an articulated fusion cannon that rotates and fires pinballs back at players.
- ROLL OUT AND FIGHT: Watchout as Soundwave’s cassette deck locks pinballs before launching them into high-intensity action.
- Collect Energon Cubes to Power Up: Store Energon Cubes to power up, team up with the Dinobots, collect Transformers Tech Spec cards, and prepare for a climactic battle against Megatron.
